purpose: Correct the replacement AE experiment without representing it as V108 replication.

features.meaning: Channel mean and extreme summaries of eight time statistics and spectral entropy, centroid, spread from the V12 per-acquisition 100D cache.
features.fitting: Device-local training partition only; median center, max(MAD, std, epsilon) scale; asinh standardized values; maximum absolute departure across a device's streams.

partition: Reuse exact original chronological 60/20/20 healthy indices and all fault test indices. Five unknown-onset devices retain assumed commissioning, explicitly unverified.
model: Same 22-4-22 AE, 202 parameters, initialization and FedAdam settings as thesis_70_device_federated_protocol.json; 12 rounds; no fault rows.

threshold.event_guard: Maximum calibration k-th largest rolling score plus three robust standard deviations of that calibration statistic. Only complete calibration windows; use individual calibration maximum if too short.
threshold.statistical_guarantee: Empirical guard; no guaranteed false alarm rate under drift or serial dependence.

evaluation.alarm_state: Continuous over calibration and subsequent observations; do not reset at known fault onset.
evaluation.primary_success: Fault lifecycle: no alarm during held-out healthy data and at least one persistent fault alarm; healthy control: no held-out healthy alarm.

scaling: Reuse all 3571 original client subsets at N=2,4,...,70 for the predesignated primary; all 2415 pairs at N=2.
claim_boundary: V108 used supervised source heads and a different cohort/metric. This is a healthy-only AE research experiment.
Raw cached per-acquisition features are used; learned prediction caches do not enter the new feature matrix.
Labels define retrospective partitions and scoring; prediction and calibration receive no outcome values.
Five assumed commissioning devices do not have verified healthy training labels.
Communication remains an analytical payload screen, not RF or hardware validation.
